title: Ole Talk, Kaiso & Pan
summary: Two Calypso History Month evenings of vintage calypso, extempo and soca on steel with the National Steel Symphony Orchestra for TT$150 per event.
description: The National Steel Symphony Orchestra presents two Friday evenings at the Batimamselle Room, NAPA Hotel: Vintage & Extempo on 2 October 2026 and Soca on Steel on 9 October 2026. The ticketing page lists TT$150 admission per event and limited seating.

validity.recurrence: Two Friday events: 2 October and 9 October 2026.

editorialNote: Current ticketing page confirms two October 2026 performances and TT$150 admission per event. The ticketing calendar lists the 2 October session from 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM; the event page confirms both dates but does not separately state the 9 October hours.
